preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(grid) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid is square (N x N).

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell == 0 or cell == 1 for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either 0 (water) or 1 (land).
The grid size N satisfies 1 ≤ N ≤ 100.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if all(cell == 0 for row in grid) or all(cell == 1 for row in grid) else max_distance
postconditions.description: If the grid contains no land (all 0s) or no water (all 1s), return -1. Otherwise, return the maximum Manhattan distance from any water cell to its nearest land cell.

postconditions.expression: max_distance == max(abs(x - lx) + abs(y - ly) for x in range(len(grid)) for y in range(len(grid)) if grid[x][y] == 0 for lx in range(len(grid)) for ly in range(len(grid)) if grid[lx][ly] == 1)
postconditions.description: The returned value is the maximum Manhattan distance from any water cell (0) to its nearest land cell (1).
